text:
maya: Heads up — I'm going to kick off the v9 regional canary toggle in ~20m. Plan: 1% global slice -> 2% EU-only -> 5% NA if green. I already opened the infra quota ticket.
kevin: Got it. What's the exact flag name and the safe abort command?
maya: Flag is `model_v9_toggle`. Abort is ` /rollout set model_v9_toggle 0% ` or just hit the abort button in the rollout UI. For automation we also have fallback to v8 if error rate crosses threshold.
tia: I'll add perf SLOs/alerts to the dashboard (p50/p95/p99 + error rate). Will paste link when done.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled - rolling -> model_v9_toggle = 1% at 2025-08-12T14:20:00Z (job id: rb-6742)
lucas: Quick Q — do we need gateway throttle changes? if traffic shifts, eu-west may need higher burst tokens.
kevin: Also, Dedicated instances currently capped at 120 rps per shard. Can we temporarily increase to 200 for the first 10 minutes of the roll?
maya: Yes, requested temporary bump with eng-infra (ticket INF-3198). Note: KV-cache warmup will cause some initial p95 spikes, expect a brief tail for first ~5k sessions.
tia: Dashboard added: https://console.redwood.ai/d/rollouts/model_v9?panelId=alerts — watching alerts, will DM the link to @sre-oncall.
sre-oncall: I'm on standby. If we see >15% relative error increase or p99 > +500ms we abort. Please @ me on the thread for any anomalies. :thumbsup:
kevin: For safety, can we gate the EU -> NA step on the regional error rate staying within 5% of baseline for 30m?
maya: Yes — gating policy: region_error_delta < 5% over 30m AND p95 latency delta < 200ms. I'll encode that in the rollout policy.
sre-oncall: Also recommend enabling request sampling for a random 0.1% of v9 responses so we can run quick quality checks on sample outputs.
maya: Good call — enabling sampling `sampling.rate=0.001` now.
kevin: I'll leave a CR with the flag changes: `infra/rollouts/2025-08-v9-toggle` — ping me for review.
lucas: Noted. I'll keep an eye on gateway metrics and pre-warm a couple of shards in eu-west-1.
maya: Thanks team. I'll post an update here after the 1% step completes. If anyone sees anything odd before then, @sre-oncall and @maya will be primary contacts.
